subject: history
topic: Why the 'Great Peace' of the 19th century was built on chemical warfare
angle: The sources focus on the 20th-century development of organophosphorus chemistry and modern detection/protection technologies rather than 19th-century industrial chemistry.
title: The Limits of Chemical History

hooks.text: You assume historical peace, but the evidence is limited.
You rely on safety standards built before modern threats.
A laboratory table with glass vials.

reveal.headline: Organophosphorus chemistry advanced in the late 20th century.
reveal.body: The evidence shows rapid progress in these compounds occurred in the second half of the 20th century.

explain.headline: The evidence is mixed and limited.
explain.body: They focus on modern chemical warfare and detection.

matters.headline: The history of safety is a modern construction.
matters.body: That may be why our current protective materials were designed before the very agents they were meant to counter were even invented.

example.headline: A filtration mask in a warehouse.
example.body: You see the standard equipment used for safety today.

question.headline: What protects you from what hasn't been invented yet?

claims.text: Chlorine-loaded MOF/fiber composites can detoxify sulfur-mustard-based chemical warfare agents and simulants within minutes of exposure.
claims.quote: We then created chlorine-loaded MOF/fiber composites that act as biocidal and reactive textiles that are capable of not only detoxifying sulfur-mustard-based chemical warfare agents and simulants

claims.text: Filtration materials currently in common use were designed before organophosphorus compounds were used as chemical weapons.
claims.quote: The filtration materials currently in common use for protection against chemical warfare agents were designed before organophosphorus compounds were used as chemical weapons.

claims.text: The USSR developed the FOLIANT and NOVICHOK programs as a reaction to the English/American invention of the VX agent.
claims.quote: Both programs were developed by the USSR as a reaction to English/American invention of VX agent.

claims.text: Organophosphorus compounds have been used as chemical warfare agents in both military operations and for terrorist purposes.
claims.quote: In addition to commercial and peaceful applications, they were used as chemical warfare agents (CWA), both in military operations and for terrorist purposes.

claims.text: Rapid progress in organophosphorus chemistry occurred in the second half of the 20th century.
claims.quote: Rapid progress in organophosphorus chemistry in the second half of the 20th century is also described.
